title: Iterated split search agrees with polynomial search
statement: For natural numbers $C,e$ and a Boolean word $w$, searching the indices $0,\ldots,|w|$ for the first one at which the acceptance test holds after iterating the split step from the empty word gives the same optional index as solving $i+C(i+1)^e=|w|$ by searching the same range.
